main_text.head: CAPUT X.
De Mista numeratione.
main_text.p: HACTENVS de simplici numeratione: superest Mista, in qua dati numerandi sunt integra cum partibus. Atque haec quoque numeratio non secus quàm partiu duplex est, Accidentalis, praeter dictas reductiones, tum integrorum, tum mistorum reductione ad Partes absoluitur.

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an H, joined to the word "ACTENVS" as "HACTENVS". The diagram labels are read from the brace structure; the "D." before "Mista" is taken as a printed letter mark. "partiu" is printed as such, probably for partium. The left strip of the scan shows the edge of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.
